archetypes.name: rebalance-correctness
archetypes.rationale: The change must keep feasibility and packing on one filtered workload.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the rebalance helper for plan fidelity around shard workload selection. Confirm the warning preflight and packer receive the same measured dict, and that before/after spread reporting compares the new layout on both sides. Check edge cases for empty workloads, zero shards, and orphan timing rows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
